title: Apple's Market Capitalization Surpasses $5 Trillion
description: Apple has reached a market capitalization of over $5 trillion following praise for its Siri AI, making it the second company ever to achieve this valuation.

sources.title: Apple tikt beurswaarde van 5.000 miljard dollar aan na lof voor Siri AI

sections.heading: Market Capitalization Milestone
paragraphs: Apple has achieved a significant milestone in its corporate valuation, with its market capitalization surpassing $5 trillion, according to De Tijd, Trends.be, and NU.

sections.heading: Praise for Siri AI
paragraphs: The increase in Apple's market capitalization has been attributed to positive feedback for its Siri AI, as reported by De Tijd.

sections.heading: Historical Context
paragraphs: Trends.be notes that Apple is only the second company to ever reach a valuation of $5 trillion.

faq.a: Beurswaarde, or market capitalization, is the total market value of a company's outstanding shares of stock.
According to De Tijd, the increase is due to positive feedback for Apple's Siri AI.

faq.q: Is Apple the first company to reach a $5 trillion beurswaarde?
faq.a: No, Trends.be reports that Apple is the second company ever to achieve this valuation.
